scenes.heading: Run a service
scenes.sub: Ten minutes. Then you run one yourself.
scenes.say: In the next ten minutes you will learn to run a service, and then run a short one yourself.

scenes.heading: By the end you can
items: Go live and move through slides
Show songs, readings and a sermon deck
Blank the screen in an instant
Close the service when it ends
scenes.say: By the end you will go live and move through slides, show songs, readings and a sermon deck, blank the screen in an instant, and close the service when it ends.

scenes.text: Nothing reaches the screen until you send it.
scenes.say: There is one rule. Nothing reaches the screen in the room until you send it.

scenes.heading: On Sunday, open the service
scenes.say: On a Sunday, you start by opening the service for live in Present. This training is already open, so you are ready.

scenes.heading: Press Space
scenes.say: Press Space for the next part.
